newsitem.title: USA: Colorado feedlot cattle lightly traded - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Colorado feedlot cattle lightly traded - USDA.

text.p: Trading on slaughter cattle very slow Wednesday. Slaughter steers and heifers not established.
Week to date total includes 9,000 head sold on a contract or formula basis for this week's delivery.
Sales reported on 450 steers and 50 heifers.
Slaughter steers: Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs 68.00.
Carcass basis: Select and Choice 2-3 1250 lbs 108.00.
Slaughter heifers: Load Select and Choice 2-3 1100 lbs 68.00.
Confirmed Sales: 500 Last Week: 1,500 Last Year: 8,900
Week to Date : 9,700 Last Week: 32,200 Last year: 23,400
